note: issue 657: classified by reading the code (imports and what each file does); the dominant layer wins and `mixed` records the honest exceptions. A new entry under packages/*/src must be added here: test/architecture-layers.test.mjs fails without it.

adapters.evidence: adapters/sqlite: the node:sqlite storage adapter, its migrations and transaction helper (4 of 4 files import node:sqlite)

adrs.evidence: pure parsing and linking of decision records (model, parse, link); no node: import in any file

agent-config.evidence: reads the Claude and Codex configuration files from disk (6 of 10 files import node:fs)
agent-config.mixed: model.ts, parse.ts and frontmatter.ts are pure; reading.ts, claude.ts, codex.ts, projects.ts, skills.ts do the file reading

agent-instructions.evidence: model and import resolution of instruction files; no node:fs import (reading goes through a function the caller passes)

api.evidence: HTTP routes and the server: 52 of 84 files import node:http types, 13 node:fs; routes answer through send(res, status, body)
api.mixed: ports.ts, event-phrase.ts and a few *-route.ts files hold small pure helpers next to the routes

app-update.evidence: a single state file that reads the change feed (imports ../changes) and holds the update state; no IO of its own

changes.evidence: the change feed served to clients: cursor, long poll (http.ts) and SSE (stream.ts); 2 of 6 files import node:http

clouds.evidence: AWS SSO and login connectors that read the AWS config and cache on disk (3 of 5 files import node:fs, 1 node:child_process)

context.evidence: context window model and measurement (model, measurement, window); no IO
context.mixed: migration.ts holds SQL and recording.ts writes through the storage port

cost.evidence: price table, floor and aggregation of cost; pure functions, no node: import

decisions.evidence: registry, hub, inference and capture orchestrate over the decisions port (port.ts); 12 files
decisions.mixed: sqlite.ts and migration.ts are the SQLite adapter (edge); capture-hooks.ts and capture-transcript.ts read hook payloads and transcripts

dev-console.evidence: service, reader, sessions and contexts compose the work source and the github sources; 1 of 7 files calls the network

diagnosis.evidence: machine diagnosis through OS adapters (linux, darwin, system, parsers: 5 of 8 files under adapters/); diagnose.ts and model.ts are the pure part

docker.evidence: inventory, catalog and service over the tools runner (imports ../tools); no direct node: IO

framework-install.evidence: plan, diff, merge and pull-request steps for installing the framework; catalog and model are pure
framework-install.mixed: detect.ts reads the repository from disk (1 of 8 files imports node:fs)

github.evidence: work board, work plan, work queue and work issue services and models over the github sources (43 files; only 9 touch node:sqlite, node:http or fetch)
github.mixed: sqlite-cache.ts, work-board-history.ts, work-execution-runs.ts, work-plan-runs.ts, work-queue-store.ts are SQLite adapters, github-source.ts and connection/ call GitHub: all edge

history.evidence: history reading composes cost and decisions (imports ../cost, ../decisions); model.ts holds the request parsing

identity.ts.evidence: provider and account identity types and helpers; imports nothing

index.ts.evidence: the package barrel: re-exports the model, the storage port and the SQLite adapter, and wires them for the other packages

ingest.evidence: hook receiver and transcript importer: HTTP receiver (hooks/receiver.ts) and file followers (history/*.ts); 2 of 11 files import node:fs, 1 node:http

mcp.evidence: MCP server over stdio and HTTP and its tools (stdio.ts, http.ts, cli.ts); owner credentials and the fleet client

messaging.evidence: service and orders over the ports declared in ports.ts; model.ts holds the rules (rate limit, text check)
messaging.mixed: adapters/ (sessions-dir, socket-check, socket-inbox, audit-file, transcript-turns) are the edge: they use node:fs and node:net

model.ts.evidence: the data model of sessions, agents, events and tokens; imports only identity.ts

owner.evidence: the core process: lock file, installation, start guard, probe and CLI (6 of 13 files import node:fs, 5 node:http or node:net)
owner.mixed: start.ts and owner.ts also wire the core together, which is composition work

permissions.evidence: permission request model, digest, refusal codes and terminal-only rule; no node: import in any file

plan.evidence: session plan model and extraction from tool output; no IO
plan.mixed: recording.ts and history.ts write through the storage port

ports.evidence: releases a listening network port: reads lsof or ss and signals a process (release.ts); the folder is about network ports, not hexagonal ports

pricing.ts.evidence: price per model on top of model.ts; pure

profiles.evidence: reads Claude profile folders from disk (3 of 5 files import node:fs)

runtime.evidence: the managed runtime service, billing policy, contracts and auth probes (service.ts, billing-policy.ts, contracts.ts)
runtime.mixed: sqlite.ts and migration.ts are the SQLite adapter; billing-diagnostic-cli.ts is a CLI entry

settings.evidence: installation settings persisted in SQLite (installation-settings.ts imports node:sqlite) and their migration

simulator.evidence: the demo and fake world: scenarios, workflows and fake github that feed the services; 1 of 18 files touches node:fs
simulator.mixed: fake-github.ts and fake-github-auth.ts are test doubles for an edge; cli.ts is an entry point

states.evidence: the machine state rules and machine (rules.ts, machine.ts) and the inbox that feeds them
states.mixed: watcher.ts, probe.ts and inbox.ts touch the file system and sockets (edge)

storage-port.ts.evidence: the storage port: the interface the use cases depend on and the SQLite adapter implements; imports only model types

telemetry.evidence: service, sampler, alerts, series and placement orchestrate machine sampling over ports.ts (29 files; 7 import node:fs, 5 node:http or node:net)
telemetry.mixed: adapters/ (linux, darwin, system, sqlite, loopback-http) and remote.ts are the edge; model.ts, series.ts, alerts.ts are pure

tools.evidence: tool executor, runner, probes and containers: run commands and fetch versions (5 of 13 files import node:fs, 2 node:child_process or node:http, runner.ts calls fetch)
tools.mixed: catalog.ts, plan.ts and store.ts are pure or SQLite

transcription.evidence: installs and runs whisper: downloads the model with fetch and writes it to disk (both files import node:fs)

vendor.evidence: vendored third-party smol-toml parser (plain .js files, not authored here); it parses an external format, so it sits at the boundary
vendor.mixed: not authored code: no layer fits exactly, edge is the closest because it only parses outside input

gerar.ts.evidence: a script that reads and writes brand asset files (imports node:fs); a Portuguese file name frozen by the legacy list of the English guard
